title: guardrails/sandbox Firecracker microVM spec
description: Declared microVM specification for the optional Firecracker executor (flag-gated OFF, IaC doctrine). The executor ships as a declared seam only - no real Firecracker-go-sdk lifecycle is implemented; this schema is the contract a deployment would instantiate when the flag is turned on.

kernelPath.description: Path to the uncompressed kernel image.

rootfsPath.description: Path to the root filesystem image.

stateDir.description: Directory for Firecracker socket / state files.

hostDevName.description: Host tap device name (e.g. tap0); null/absent for no network.

jailer.description: Optional jailer binary path for the microVM.
